limitations: Not a validation of the full SAM thermal/electric/annual test.
Simple aiming is an explicit optical study assumption, not an operator aiming strategy.
Pillbox sun and pinned atmospheric defaults are model assumptions.
Energy convergence of dimensional maps is constrained by built-in normalization.
Hermite evaluates midpoint samples; cell-average terminology refers only to the piecewise-constant map representation.
